subject: Implementation roadmap & integrated MAP — VelocityMed
messages:
From: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@velocitymed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@velocitymed.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation kickoff — MAP + timelines

Tessa / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency guarantees and the KV-caching plan. We're ready to lock down the post-signature MAP so our internal PMO can schedule dependencies.

High-level asks from our side:
- 8-week go-live target from DOC-SIGN completion (targeting early Aug).
- Canary window needs to be limited to 48 hours with rollback playbook.
- Training: 2 half-day sessions for 20 support engineers, plus an admin deep-dive.
- Migration: nightly batch migration from our legacy service for first 7 days; full traffic cutover on a single weekend.

Attaching a first-pass list of internal stakeholders. Can you propose a draft MAP with milestones (gates, owner, acceptance criteria)? Also need SSO/SCIM onboarding steps and an initial list of required production logs for our security team.

Thanks,
Elaine Kim
Director, Platform Operations
VelocityMed

Attachment: onboarding_contacts.csv (contact list stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@velocitymed.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@velocitymed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP + timelines

Elaine — very excited to move this forward. I've embedded the post-signature implementation plan in a MAP workbook (VelocityMed_MAP_v1.xlsx) and sketched the milestones below for your PMO. See the attached for the gating checklist and owners.

Summary (draft):
- DocuSign complete: Day 0
- SSO/SCIM test account + audit logs access: Day 3 (owner: VelocityMed / Redwood SRE)
- Canary wave 1 (2% traffic) — Day 10–11 (48h window; rollback tested in staging)
- Canary wave 2 (20% traffic) — Day 17–18 (48h window)
- Migration window (incremental batch sync): Day 19–25 (nights)
- Training: Admin deep-dive (1 day) Day 5; Operator sessions (two half days) Day 12 and Day 13
- Full cutover weekend: Day 28 (Sat/Sun) with fallbacks to N-1 within 2 hours
- Acceptance: post-cutover 7-day monitoring window (metrics & quality checks)

Key notes / asks:
- Canary sizing: Marcus, can you confirm the GPU pool allocation for the two canary waves? We recommend reserving a dedicated slot to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
- Logs: Laura, please attach the minimal event schema we will publish to VelocityMed's logging endpoint. Elaine — security will want a 30-day audit log retention snapshot; we can provide 30-day exports via S3.
- Training roster: please confirm attendees and preferred timezone — attached is our proposed schedule (Training_Roster_Jun-Jul_2028.csv).

I'll wait for your confirmation on the high-level dates and then we'll lock owners in the MAP workbook and create a shared tracker (Drive link below). Once you confirm, I'll open a HubSpot milestone task and create the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: VelocityMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook — milestones, owners, gates)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP + timelines

Tessa / team — tagging in on canary capacity and the rollback plan. Quick notes:

- Canary allocation: I can reserve a 1-GPU node pool dedicated to VelocityMed for the 48h windows; that should be more than enough for 2% and 20% traffic phases given their token distribution.
- Autoscaling policy: recommend a max burst headroom of 30% for wave 2 to avoid throttling during traffic spikes.
- Fallbacks: we will implement model-variant fallback + region failover (if they want multi-region). That will add ~6 hours to cutover prep.
- Observability: Dylan, please prepare dashboards for token-level latency and per-route error rate, and wire an alert to VelocityMed's PagerDuty for any production 5xx anomalies.

I'll add these items into the MAP workbook under "Infra & Fallbacks" so owners are explicit.

-Marcus
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@velocitymed.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — MAP + timelines

Elaine — added the security and training artifacts to the shared Drive folder. Short summary:

- SSO/SCIM checklist (docs + test account instructions) uploaded: /drive/folders/1a2b3c4-velocitymed-implementation
- Audit log export cadence: daily snapshots to S3 (retention 30 days) + on-demand 90-day export available as part of our compliance package
- Training plan: Admin deep-dive (2 hours, recorded) + two operator sessions (90 minutes each, hands-on). Proposed times: Jul 6 (Admin, 10am PT), Jul 12 & 13 (Ops, 9am–10:30am PT).

Please review and confirm attendee list. Once we have DocuSign executed, we'll lock calendar invites and the canary windows in the MAP workbook.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
